WITH counted_types AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(type_count) as total_count,
    AVG(type_count) as avg_count
  FROM counted_types
)
SELECT 
  ct.tradekind,
  ct.type_count,
  CAST(ct.type_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(s.total_count AS NUMERIC) as proportion,
  ct.type_count - s.avg_count as above_avg
FROM counted_types ct
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE ct.type_count > s.avg_count
  AND s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
